message.sgcraft.addresses.group_full: World %s has no symbol because group %s already has %s worlds. Addresses of 8 or 9 symbols can't reach it
message.sgcraft.addresses.too_many_group: Group %s is left out because a server can have only %s groups. Its worlds are in the default group
message.sgcraft.addresses.bad_cell_chunk: A cell is 1 to %s chunks across
command.sgcraft.config.unknown: There's no setting called %s. /sgcraft config lists them
command.sgcraft.config.header: SGCraft's settings. /sgcraft config <key> shows what one does:
command.sgcraft.config.restart: Changes take effect when the server next starts
setting.sgcraft.not_saved: The settings file couldn't be written, so the change lasts only until the server stops. The server log says why
setting.sgcraft.not_written: The settings file couldn't be written, so nothing changed. The server log says why
setting.sgcraft.set_next: %s will be %s when the server next starts
setting.sgcraft.gates.chunk_loading_rang: How many chunks around a busy gate's own stay loaded while it dials or holds a wormhole open
setting.sgcraft.gates.kawoosh_breaks_unb: Whether a kawoosh clears blocks that can't be broken, such as bedrock
setting.sgcraft.gates.owners_break_gates: Whether a gate's owner can break it even when the gate is set unbreakable
setting.sgcraft.gates.generated_gates_br: Whether players can break the gates that generate with the world, unless a gate is set otherwise
setting.sgcraft.gates.wormholes_jump.tip: Whether an open wormhole moves to another gate in the same cell when the gate it reaches is broken
setting.sgcraft.gates.log_events.tip: Whether gates forming and breaking, and wormholes opening, closing and going astray, are written to the server log
setting.sgcraft.tools.range.tip: How far from a player, in blocks, the handheld tools look for a gate
setting.sgcraft.remote_view.horizontal_r: How far out from the camera a remote view sends blocks, in blocks
setting.sgcraft.remote_view.vertical_rad: How far above and below the camera a remote view sends blocks, in blocks
setting.sgcraft.remote_view.bytes_per_ti: About how many bytes of blocks each viewer is sent each tick. A new view fills in at this rate
setting.sgcraft.energy.per_naquadah.tip: How much gate energy one naquadah gives a DHD or a battery
setting.sgcraft.energy.power_unit_capaci: The most gate energy a power unit holds
Whether players in creative mode dial without using energy
setting.sgcraft.energy.dial_costs.per_ch: Whether a gate pays energy as each chevron locks
How much energy a gate pays as each chevron locks, before distance
setting.sgcraft.energy.dial_costs.open.e: Whether a gate pays energy as its wormhole opens
How much energy a gate pays as its wormhole opens, before distance
setting.sgcraft.energy.dial_costs.per_ti: Whether a gate pays energy each tick its wormhole stays open
How much energy a gate pays each tick its wormhole stays open, before distance
setting.sgcraft.energy.multipliers.dista: How much more a wormhole costs the farther it reaches
setting.sgcraft.energy.multipliers.inter: How many times more a wormhole costs with an eighth chevron, which reaches another world
setting.sgcraft.energy.multipliers.other: How many times more again a wormhole costs with a ninth chevron, which reaches another group of worlds
setting.sgcraft.energy.multipliers.super: How many times more a wormhole to or from a supergate costs
setting.sgcraft.energy.bridge_rates.fe_i: How many FE buy one gate energy, from cables and other mods' chargers
setting.sgcraft.energy.bridge_rates.fe_o: How many FE one gate energy gives, from an energy converter or a battery other mods draw on
setting.sgcraft.energy.converter_rate.ti: The most gate energy an energy converter turns into FE each tick
setting.sgcraft.zpm.capacity.tip: How much gate energy a full ZPM holds
setting.sgcraft.zpm.search_range.tip: How far from a gate or a city shield the ZPMs it draws on can be, in blocks along each axis
setting.sgcraft.zpm.tainted_explosion.ti: How big the explosion is when energy is drawn from a tainted ZPM in a console, cart or hub
setting.sgcraft.zpm.chest_chance.tip: The chance, in percent, that a generated gate has a chest beside it holding a ZPM
setting.sgcraft.zpm.tainted_chance.tip: The chance, in percent, that a ZPM found in such a chest is tainted
setting.sgcraft.shields.gate_energy_per_: How much energy a gate's shield takes each tick while it is raised. It can be a fraction
setting.sgcraft.shields.console_range.ti: How far from a shield console, in blocks, the gate it works can be
setting.sgcraft.shields.city_energy_per_: How much energy a city shield takes each tick for each million blocks it holds
The most blocks a city shield reaches from its generator, each way
setting.sgcraft.shields.city_power_reach: How far from a city shield generator, in blocks along each axis, the power units it draws from can be
setting.sgcraft.shields.city_keeps_chunk: Whether a raised city shield keeps every chunk under it loaded
setting.sgcraft.malp.battery_capacity.ti: The most gate energy a battery holds
setting.sgcraft.malp.power_unit_charge_r: How much gate energy a power unit puts into the battery in its slot each tick
setting.sgcraft.malp.charger_charge_rate: How much gate energy a battery charger puts into its battery each tick
setting.sgcraft.malp.idle_drain.tip: How much gate energy a MALP uses each tick while someone watches its feed
setting.sgcraft.malp.drive_drain.tip: How much gate energy a MALP uses for each block it drives
setting.sgcraft.malp.signal_range.tip: How far, in blocks, a console or tablet reaches a MALP directly, and reaches a gate to relay through
setting.sgcraft.malp.linger_ticks.tip: How long a MALP's chunks stay loaded after its driver leaves it, in ticks
setting.sgcraft.malp.console_damage_inte: Whether a player at a MALP console who takes damage is taken off it
How many of the players near a console, nearest first, see the feed on its monitor, whether or not anyone is at it. Each costs the server a stream of the world around the MALP. 0 shows it to none
setting.sgcraft.malp.spectator_range.tip: How near a console, in blocks, a player must be to see the feed on its monitor
setting.sgcraft.malp.tablet_drain.tip: How much gate energy a MALP tablet uses from its own battery each tick while it shows a live feed
setting.sgcraft.worldgen.naquadah_ore.en: Whether naquadah ore generates at all. /sgcraft ore dimension_ids sets the worlds it generates in
setting.sgcraft.worldgen.naquadah_ore.ad: Whether chunks made without naquadah ore, such as before SGCraft was added, get it when they load
setting.sgcraft.worldgen.naquadah_ore.ge: One chunk in this many gets clusters under lava. 0 gives none
setting.sgcraft.worldgen.naquadah_ore.ma: The most columns of a chunk searched for lava. Each gives a cluster wherever lava lies on a solid block
setting.sgcraft.worldgen.naquadah_ore.ge: One chunk in this many gets nodes away from lava. 0 gives none
setting.sgcraft.worldgen.naquadah_ore.ma: The most nodes away from lava such a chunk gets
setting.sgcraft.worldgen.village_gates.w: How often villages build a gate plaza, against the other pieces they can build. 0 builds none
setting.sgcraft.worldgen.village_gates.t: Whether a Tok'ra stands in front of a village's gate once it is built
screen.sgcraft.settings.cell.hint: Chunks across each cell, from 1 to %s. A cell of 8 chunks is 128 blocks
screen.sgcraft.settings.option.restart: Takes effect when the server next starts
screen.sgcraft.settings.client.section: Your own settings. They change nothing for other players
screen.sgcraft.settings.client.hd_event_: Whether the event horizon is drawn with its detailed texture, rather than the original's plain one
screen.sgcraft.settings.client.copy_addr: Whether opening a gate's base screen copies the gate's address to the clipboard
screen.sgcraft.settings.client.sound_vol: How loud SGCraft's sounds play, from 0 for silent to 1 for full volume, on top of the game's own volume settings
screen.sgcraft.settings.client.not_saved: Your settings file couldn't be written, so the change lasts only until the game closes. The log says why
screen.sgcraft.settings.cell.tip: How many chunks across each of this world's cells is. Gates in one cell share an address. Changing it gives every gate in the world a new address
screen.sgcraft.settings.cell.every.tip: How many chunks across the cells are in every world without a cell size of its own
screen.sgcraft.settings.save.tip: Saves the changes made on this screen, and shows them to every other operator with it open
screen.sgcraft.settings.leave.text: The changes made on this screen haven't been saved. Leaving drops them
screen.sgcraft.settings.unsaved: Changes not saved yet. Save keeps them, and Discard drops them
screen.sgcraft.settings.client_note.save: Changes apply when you save them
screen.sgcraft.settings.options_note.sav: Changes apply when you save them, except those marked * which take effect when the server next starts
message.sgcraft.dialing_computer.unlinke: No stargate is in reach of this computer
message.sgcraft.dialing_computer.iris_de: You may not work this gate's iris
screen.sgcraft.dialing_computer.mode.tip: How this computer dials: as its gate's settings say, slowly (a chevron at a time) or quickly (every chevron at once)
screen.sgcraft.dialing_computer.alarm.ti: Turns off the alarm that sounds while a wormhole comes in, or turns it on again. It stays that way until changed
setting.sgcraft.computers.link_range.tip: How far from a dialing computer, in blocks, the base of the gate it dials can be
setting.sgcraft.computers.chair_reach.ti: How far in front of a dialing computer, in blocks, its office chair can stand
setting.sgcraft.computers.requires_power: Whether dialing computers and MALP consoles need gate energy from power units or ZPMs near them to run
setting.sgcraft.computers.energy_per_tic: How much gate energy a dialing computer or MALP console uses each tick while it is switched on. It can be a fraction
setting.sgcraft.computers.power_reach.ti: How far from a dialing computer or MALP console, in blocks along each axis, the power units and ZPMs it draws on can be
message.sgcraft.computer.on_no_power: Computer switched on, but it has no power
screen.sgcraft.computer_config.requires_: Whether the computer runs on gate energy from the power units and ZPMs near it. Off, it uses no energy and runs without them
screen.sgcraft.computer_config.no_owner: Owner: none, so only operators configure it
screen.sgcraft.computer_config.server_fr: The server runs every computer without power
message.sgcraft.computer.cannot_configur: You aren't allowed to configure this computer
screen.sgcraft.malp_config.name: Name
screen.sgcraft.malp_config.name.tip: The MALP's name, as consoles, tablets and commands list it. Left blank, it takes its first name back
screen.sgcraft.malp_console.unpair: Unpair %s from this console. Only its owner and operators can
message.sgcraft.malp.loading: That MALP is loading. Try again in a moment
screen.sgcraft.malp_console.heading: HEADING
setting.sgcraft.computers.history_size.t: How many of the addresses last dialed from a dialing computer its screen lists, to dial again. 0 keeps none
screen.sgcraft.dialing_computer.iris.tip: Shuts the gate's iris, or raises its shield, when it is open, and opens it when it is shut. It shows red while open, since anything can come through
message.sgcraft.addresses.bad_secret_lay: The secret layout is true or false
